g.text: Formal scope: 4,190,209 packet modes, 29,822,521 interaction pairs, 16,760,836 tensor prefixes, and 24/24 exact checks. Display curves use floating point only for presentation.

text.style: font-size: 3.75px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif', 'Times New Roman', 'Times', serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b675f

g.text: Conclusion: output multiplicity and isotropic square functions do not force an extra shell factor in the first critical Picard iterate. This is not norm inflation, nonlinear remainder control, or a regularity proof.
